name: musicfit
description: Fit a music track to a video cut: exactly the length you need, cut and looped on bar lines, the drop on the second you pick and a fade that ends on a beat.

interface.shortDescription: Fit music to a video cut
interface.longDescription: Makes a music track exactly as long as your video by cutting or looping whole bars, lands its drop on the second you pick, ends it with a fade that resolves on a beat, ducks it under a voice and sets its loudness. Writes fitted.wav and cues.json with every beat and bar as frame numbers. Needs Node 22 or newer and ffmpeg, and no API key.
defaultPrompt: Fit track.mp3 to my 30 second video
